description: space.rs/handle_space_set update loop uses args.get("update").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) (borrow) instead of args.remove("update") (owned). This forces: (1) id_str.clone() on every branch in the loop body (lines 393, 423, 444, 457, 463, 466, 470); (2) patch_val.get(field) + v.clone() (line 438) for each metadata field when building clean_patch, instead of patch_val.remove(field) with a move. All other set handlers in the crate were fixed in JMAP-4ii.57/58 — space.rs was missed.
title: space.rs update loop: args.get borrow forces id_str.clone() and v.clone()
